# Being There Community Edition v0.1.0 — self-hosted technical preview

**Audience:** technically capable operators hosting private family instances. This is application source, not a hosted service, medical device, or beginner installer.

## Included

- Family-owned, invite-only Google OAuth sign-in (requires your own credentials, registered HTTPS redirect, and trusted proxy).
- Multiple people within a family, private photos and original media, independent text/audio stories, family-isolated access and revocation.
- Locally mounted or synchronized folder intake; original bytes retained in a family-owned archive.
- Private archive export and isolated restore without importing sessions, accounts, invitations or access grants.
- Synthetic integration, recovery and HTTPS browser acceptance tests runnable from the public repository.

## Install and operate

See [technical-preview installation and limits](../../packages/app/README.md) and the [repository quickstart](../../README.md). From `packages/app`, install with `npm ci --omit=dev --ignore-scripts`; configure `APP_ORIGIN`, `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`, `GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET`, and `DATA_DIR` privately; start with `npm run family:start`, fronted by your HTTPS reverse proxy. Provision invitations using the operator CLI, never an unauthenticated setup page.

To verify the source: `npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run check && node scripts/recovery-drill.mjs`, followed by `npx playwright install --with-deps chromium --only-shell && npm run test:browser`. [Public verification workflow](https://github.com/Being-There/community/actions/workflows/community-app.yml) provides commit-specific results.

## Known limitations and safety

- Real Google-account onboarding, real external deployment, independent security/accessibility review and novice installation **are not yet validated**; synthetic OIDC and browser tests do not establish them.
- This release is **not** a turnkey managed backup system. Originals and snapshots need separate off-device backups and a real recovery drill.
- Mounted/synced Google Drive folders are supported as ordinary local folders; direct Drive OAuth/automatic synchronization is **not implemented**.
- Supported still images are JPEG/PNG/WebP; HEIC and video import are not supported. Recording length/recovery depend on device/browser quota. There is no mandatory transcription, AI backend or centralized subscription.
- Keep export files and media private. Do not post family content or incident logs to the public tracker.
- See [third-party license notices](../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md), including LGPL-licensed libvips runtime components.

The original private application, its data and Git history are not part of this public release.
